title: Thundertree · Area 1 · Western cottage

sourceRecords.title: Thundertree 1 · Western cottage
read: A roofless cottage crouches beneath a broad tree. Its doorway has almost vanished into weeds.

The weeds interrupt a straight approach to the doorway, and the open roof leaves the cottage exposed to the sky. You can examine the nearer ground, look through the ruined walls, or keep watch beneath the broad tree before choosing how to enter.

brief: Roofless WESTERN stone cottage immediately beneath the canopy of a broad tree; decayed doorway nearly swallowed by weeds. Broken stone walls, brush and old household debris. TWO twig blights remain concealed in ordinary vegetation and must NOT be visibly identifiable. Daylight, no invented gigantic glowing tree or intact modern cottage.
